weeks.title: 让对话开始
weeks.description: 介绍自己、回应、追问与澄清
weeks.outcome: 初次见面时能交换基本信息，并在没听清时请对方重复。

lessons.title: 认识新同事
lessons.goal: 交换名字和来自哪里的信息
goals: 说出名字和一座城市
用简短问题问对方来自哪里
没听清时提出重复请求

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Alex. Are you new here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是 Alex。你是新来的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Yes, I am. I'm Lin. Nice to meet you.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我是 Lin。很高兴认识你。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from?
dialogue.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。你来自哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: I'm from Chengdu. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 我来自成都。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: I'm from Bristol.
dialogue.zh: 我来自布里斯托尔。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，能再说一遍吗？

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Bristol. It's a city in the UK.
dialogue.zh: 布里斯托尔。是英国的一座城市。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Oh, I see.
dialogue.zh: 哦，明白了。

dialogue.speaker: Alex
dialogue.en: Welcome to the team!
dialogue.zh: 欢迎加入团队！

questions.explanation: Lin 用 Yes, I am. 回答了是否新来的问题。
Alex 说 I'm from Bristol.
Could you say that again? 是请对方再说一遍。

phrases.example: I'm from Shanghai.
I'm from Xi'an. What about you?
Sorry, could you say that again?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 用 Amy 和杭州做一句自我介绍。
rounds.sample: Hi, I'm Amy. I'm from Hangzhou.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 先告诉同事你来自哪里，再问对方。
rounds.sample: I'm from Nanjing. What about you?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 新同事说了一个你没听清的城市。请他说一遍，听清后接一句。
rounds.sample: Sorry, could you say that again? … Oh, I see.

pronunciation.tip: 说 I'm 时双唇轻碰一下收住 /m/，再接名字。录一句 I'm Amy，听收尾是否还在。

correction.reason: from 前面用 am，I'm 是 I am 的缩写。

review.prompt: 明天盖住台词，在十秒内说出名字和城市。
review.transfer: 入职培训时遇到另一个新同事，问他来自哪里。

rubric: 说出名字和一座城市
用简短问题问对方来自哪里
没听清时提出重复请求

partnerTask.roleA: 你是新同事，先介绍自己，再问城市。
partnerTask.roleB: 你来自 Durham。第一次按正常语速说，听到重复请求后把城市单独再说一次。
partnerTask.success: A 在请求重复后说出或复述你来自的城市。

lessons.title: 介绍工作和学习
lessons.goal: 说清在哪儿工作、负责什么、在学什么
goals: 说出一个工作地点或学习内容
用一句话说明一项工作内容
能回答一个具体的后续问题

dialogue.speaker: Rui
dialogue.en: Hi, Rui. Do you work here?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，Rui。你在这里工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Yes, I work at the front desk.
dialogue.zh: 对，我在前台工作。

dialogue.speaker: Rui
dialogue.en: What do you do there?
dialogue.zh: 你在那里负责什么？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: I help visitors find the right room.
dialogue.zh: 我帮访客找到要去的房间。

dialogue.speaker: Rui
dialogue.en: Do you study after work?
dialogue.zh: 你下班后还学习吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: Yes. I'm learning English online.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我在网上学英语。

dialogue.speaker: Rui
dialogue.en: When do you have class?
dialogue.zh: 你什么时候上课？

dialogue.speaker: Sam
dialogue.en: On Tuesdays, after dinner. I have class at home.
dialogue.zh: 周二晚饭后。我在家上课。

questions.explanation: front desk 指前台。
Rui 说自己帮 visitors 找房间。

questions.prompt: Rui 什么时候上英语课？
questions.explanation: On Tuesdays, after dinner 同时给了星期和时间。

phrases.example: I work at a hotel.
I help customers find books.
I'm learning Spanish.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 你在一家酒店工作，帮客人找房间。
rounds.sample: I work at a hotel. I help guests find their rooms.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 对方问你下班后在学什么，用自己的情况回答。
rounds.sample: I'm learning English after work.

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 你暂时没上班，正在学设计。别人问你做什么，给出真实合适的介绍。
rounds.hint: 用 I'm learning … 说现状
rounds.sample: I'm learning design. I have classes online.

pronunciation.tip: 先单说 work，嘴后部轻轻闭住 /k/，再说 work at，把 at 接上。

correction.reason: 说星期用 on；说工作地点可以用 at。

review.prompt: 从工作地点、工作内容、学习内容里抽两项做口头介绍。
review.transfer: 给兴趣课同桌介绍自己的白天工作。

rubric: 说出一个工作地点或学习内容
用一句话说明一项工作内容
能回答一个具体的后续问题

partnerTask.roleA: 你要认识培训搭档，问他在哪里工作和在学什么。
partnerTask.roleB: 你在图书馆工作，正在学做视频。学视频的内容只在对方问时回答。
partnerTask.success: A 能复述两个信息点，B 核对。

lessons.title: 把问题问回去
lessons.goal: 回答之后把问题问回去，再追问一个细节
goals: 先对原问题作出回应
回应之后把同一问题问回去
根据对方的回答追问一项细节

dialogue.speaker: Nia
dialogue.en: Is this your first day in class?
dialogue.zh: 这是你第一天来上课吗？

dialogue.speaker: Bo
dialogue.en: Yes, it is. How about you?
dialogue.zh: 对。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Nia
dialogue.en: It's my second day.
dialogue.zh: 这是我第二天来。

dialogue.speaker: Bo
dialogue.en: Where do you sit?
dialogue.zh: 你坐哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Nia
dialogue.en: Near the door. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 靠门。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Bo
dialogue.en: I sit near the window.
dialogue.zh: 我坐在窗边。

dialogue.speaker: Nia
dialogue.en: Is there a free seat next to you?
dialogue.zh: 你旁边有空位吗？

dialogue.speaker: Bo
dialogue.en: Yes. Come and sit here.
dialogue.zh: 有。过来坐吧。

questions.explanation: Bo 先说 Yes, it is，确认是第一天。
Nia 回答 I sit near the window.
next to you 指对方旁边。

phrases.zh: 把刚问你的问题抛回给对方
phrases.example: I take the bus. How about you?

phrases.zh: 请对方也说说自己的情况
phrases.example: I sit in the back. What about you?
Is there a chair by the door?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 回答你是第一天来，然后问对方。
rounds.hint: Yes, it is. + How about you?
rounds.sample: Yes, it is. How about you?

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 你坐后排，对方问你坐哪里。答完问回去。
rounds.sample: I sit in the back. What about you?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方说坐前面，你想知道旁边能不能坐。
rounds.sample: Is there a free seat next to you?

pronunciation.tip: 轻读第一个音节，把第二个音节说得更清楚。分别录 How about you? 和 What about you? 听 about 的节奏是否相同。

correction.reason: 这是固定问法，about 后面接 you。

review.prompt: 把 Where do you work? 和 Is this your first day? 各答一次，每次都问回去。
review.transfer: 换到研讨会场景，问座位并追问旁边能否坐。

rubric: 先对原问题作出回应
回应之后把同一问题问回去
根据对方的回答追问一项细节

partnerTask.roleA: 你第一次到共享办公室，想知道搭档坐哪儿。
partnerTask.roleB: 你是第二次来，坐在打印机旁边。你旁边的位置已被预订。
partnerTask.success: A 问回去后还能确认座位是否可用。

lessons.title: 请对方重复
lessons.goal: 请对方重说，并复述关键字确认
goals: 提出重说请求
用短问句找出没听准的字母
复述房间号和时间

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Can we meet in Room B at ten?
dialogue.zh: 我们能十点在 B 室见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你能再说一遍吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Room B, at ten.
dialogue.zh: 十点，B 室。

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.en: Did you say Room D?
dialogue.zh: 你刚才说的是 D 室吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: No, Room B. B as in book.
dialogue.zh: 不是，是 B 室。book 的第一个字母 B。

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.en: Got it, Room B at ten.
dialogue.zh: 明白了，十点，B 室。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Yes, that's right.
dialogue.zh: 对，没错。

dialogue.speaker: Ken
dialogue.en: Thanks. See you in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。早上见。

questions.explanation: Mia 说 B，Ken 一度听成 D。

questions.prompt: 对方用哪个单词确认 B？
questions.explanation: B as in book 用 book 的首字母确认。
Ken 最后复述了 Room B at ten。

phrases.zh: 听不清时请人再说一遍
phrases.example: Could you say that again, please?

phrases.zh: 复述没听准的部分，请对方确认
phrases.example: Did you say Room C?

phrases.zh: 告诉对方自己听明白了
phrases.example: Got it. Room A at nine.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 你完全没听清同事的话。请他重说。
rounds.sample: Sorry, could you say that again?

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 你只想确认房间是 E 还是 B。
rounds.hint: 只问你听成的那个字母
rounds.sample: Did you say Room E?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方澄清后，你确认了 F 室、八点。
rounds.sample: Got it, Room F at eight.

pronunciation.focus: 区分字母 B 和 D
pronunciation.tip: 请伙伴随机读字母 B、D 各三次，先写下听到的字母再对答案。听开头时，B 对应双唇闭合，D 对应舌尖触上齿龈。

correction.reason: did 已表示过去，后面用原形 say。

review.prompt: 不看台词练一次请人重说、确认字母和复述。
review.transfer: 电话里没听清对方说的是 Gate B 还是 Gate D，确认登机口。

rubric: 提出重说请求
用短问句找出没听准的字母
复述房间号和时间

partnerTask.roleA: 你在电话里记下会议房间和时间，请核对字母。
partnerTask.roleB: 你预约了 Room P，时间是十点。若对方问字母，可用 P as in pen。
partnerTask.success: A 说出正确的房间号和时间，B 确认。

lessons.title: 在培训签到处聊天
lessons.goal: 换到签到场景，串联自我介绍、工作、问回去和澄清
goals: 介绍名字和城市
回答工作地点后问回去
经重复核对对方的地点

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: Hi, I'm Tess. Are you here for the training?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是 Tess。你是来参加培训的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Yes. I'm Ren, from Suzhou.
dialogue.zh: 是的。我是 Ren，来自苏州。

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: Do you work in this building?
dialogue.zh: 你在这栋楼工作吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Yes, I work at the help desk. What about you?
dialogue.zh: 是的，我在服务台工作。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: I work at a small hotel.
dialogue.zh: 我在一家小酒店工作。

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你能再说一遍吗？

dialogue.speaker: Tess
dialogue.en: At a hotel. It's across the street.
dialogue.zh: 在一家酒店。就在街对面。

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Oh, the hotel across the street. Got it.
dialogue.zh: 噢，街对面那家酒店。明白了。

questions.explanation: Tess 问是否来参加培训，Ren 回答 Yes。
Ren 先确认在这栋楼工作，然后说 help desk。
across the street 指街对面。

phrases.example: I'm Mei, from Wuxi.
I work at the ticket desk.
Sorry, could you say that again?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 在签到处报名，用自己或虚构的姓名、城市介绍。
rounds.sample: I'm Kai, from Ningbo.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 同伴先问你工作地点，回答之后问回去。
rounds.sample: I work at a bank. What about you?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 你听到的是 station 但不确定。请重说，再确认对方在车站工作。
rounds.sample: Could you say that again? … At the station. Got it.

pronunciation.tip: 请同伴在同一短句里换三个地点，自己只写下地点，以此检查是否听出了有信息的词。

correction.reason: 说工作地点时，用 at 连接 work 和地点。

review.prompt: 按签到对话的顺序，默练一次介绍、工作、问回去和澄清。
review.transfer: 在社区活动报到，问同伴白天在哪儿工作。

rubric: 介绍名字和城市
回答工作地点后问回去
经重复核对对方的地点

partnerTask.roleA: 培训签到时认识搭档。说明自己在工作还是学习，并记下对方的地点。
partnerTask.roleB: 你在南站的咖啡店工作。等 A 主动追问才补充南站，必要时只重说关键信息。
partnerTask.success: A 完成自我介绍，并确认咖啡店在哪座站。

lessons.title: 在活动中心签到
lessons.goal: 独立完成初次见面的交流并核对集合信息
goals: 说出姓名和一项工作或学习内容
围绕对方的回答追问一条信息
澄清后完整复述集合位置

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: Hello, are you on the building tour?
dialogue.zh: 你好，你是来参加大楼参观的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm Leo. I work at the bike shop nearby.
dialogue.zh: 对，我是 Leo。我在附近的自行车店工作。

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: I'm Uma. I'm learning how to fix bikes.
dialogue.zh: 我是 Uma。我正在学怎么修自行车。

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: Where do you take classes?
dialogue.zh: 你在哪里上课？

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: At the Hinton Center. Where's your bike shop?
dialogue.zh: 在 Hinton 中心。你的自行车店在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: On Hall Street. The tour starts at the side door.
dialogue.zh: 在 Hall 街。参观从侧门开始。

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: Did you say the front door?
dialogue.zh: 你说的是正门吗？

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.en: The side door, by the lift.
dialogue.zh: 是侧门，在电梯旁边。

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: Okay, the side door by the lift.
dialogue.zh: 好的，电梯旁的侧门。

questions.explanation: Uma 用 I'm learning 描述自己在学什么。
Leo 说 On Hall Street，回答了店的位置。
Leo 更正 front door 并给了 by the lift 作为定位。

phrases.example: I'm learning how to fix phones.
Where's your language school?
Did you say the main door?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 签到时先介绍姓名和一项工作或学习内容。
rounds.sample: I'm Chen. I'm learning how to make videos.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 对方说自己在一家花店工作，打听店在哪里。
rounds.sample: Where's your flower shop?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 伙伴说得太快，你只听到 meet。请他重复，再复述他说的集合位置。
rounds.sample: Could you say that again? … By the main stairs. Got it.

pronunciation.focus: front 和 side 的关键词
pronunciation.tip: 分别读 front door 和 side door，把重心放在第一个词，再请同伴随机读其中一个，你指出对应的门。

correction.before: I'm learn how to fix bikes.
correction.after: I'm learning how to fix bikes.
correction.reason: I'm 后用 learning，表示目前在学。

review.prompt: 回忆测验里哪一步停顿最长，只重练那一步。
review.transfer: 在新员工参观时确认目的地是西门还是东门。

rubric: 说出姓名和一项工作或学习内容
围绕对方的回答追问一条信息
澄清后完整复述集合位置

partnerTask.roleA: 你要参加活动，和陌生搭档交换姓名及工作或学习情况，并弄清在哪里集合。
partnerTask.roleB: 你叫 Kit，在街角的面包店工作。活动在二楼接待处集合，接待处在电梯对面。
partnerTask.success: A 能说明自己做什么，并在结束前准确复述集合楼层和位置。

weeks.title: 说说平常的一天
weeks.description: 日常作息、兴趣、喜好与理由
weeks.outcome: 和熟人交换日常活动和兴趣，并能说明一个简单理由。

lessons.title: 介绍平常的一天
lessons.goal: 按时间顺序说出三项日常活动
goals: 给出一项活动的准确时间
说出另一项习惯
能说明活动在哪些日子发生

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: What time do you start work?
dialogue.zh: 你几点开始上班？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I start at nine, but I leave home at eight.
dialogue.zh: 我九点开始上班，不过八点就出门。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: Do you eat breakfast at home?
dialogue.zh: 你在家吃早餐吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: No, I have breakfast at work.
dialogue.zh: 不，我在公司吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: What do you do after work?
dialogue.zh: 你下班后做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: I usually take a walk by the river.
dialogue.zh: 我通常去河边散步。

dialogue.speaker: Ivy
dialogue.en: Do you walk every day?
dialogue.zh: 你每天都散步吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Only on weekdays. I stay home on Saturdays.
dialogue.zh: 只在工作日。周六我待在家。

questions.explanation: leave home 指离开家，后面是 at eight。
Noah 回答 I have breakfast at work。

questions.prompt: Noah 哪些日子通常去散步？
questions.explanation: Only on weekdays 限定了散步的日子。

phrases.example: I start at half past eight.
I usually cook after work.
I take the bus on weekdays.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 说明你八点上班，七点半出门。
rounds.sample: I start at eight. I leave home at half past seven.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 回答下班后通常做什么。
rounds.sample: I usually make dinner after work.

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方误以为你每天都早起，说明周末例外。
rounds.sample: I get up early on weekdays. I get up at ten on Sundays.

pronunciation.tip: 连读 start at eight，先慢读一遍，再让 at 变短，时间词 eight 说清楚。

correction.reason: 主语是 I 时，walk 用原形。

review.prompt: 不看范例说出早、中、晚各一项活动。
review.transfer: 对同伴说周六和平日不同的一项活动。

rubric: 给出一项活动的准确时间
说出另一项习惯
能说明活动在哪些日子发生

partnerTask.roleA: 你想约搭档早上一起坐车，核对出门时间和哪些天可行。
partnerTask.roleB: 平日八点十五分出门，周三在家工作，周六九点出门。
partnerTask.success: A 记录平日时间，并问出周三的例外。

lessons.title: 聊聊兴趣
lessons.englishTitle: What Do You Do for Fun?
lessons.goal: 交换兴趣和参与频率
goals: 用一句话介绍兴趣
说明什么时候或和谁参与
追问对方兴趣的具体内容

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: What do you do in your free time?
dialogue.zh: 你有空时做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.en: I take photos, mostly on weekends.
dialogue.zh: 我拍照，主要在周末。

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: What do you take photos of?
dialogue.zh: 你拍些什么？

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.en: Old buildings. I go out early on Sundays.
dialogue.zh: 老建筑。我周日一早就会出门。

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: Do you go alone?
dialogue.zh: 你一个人去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.en: Not always. I sometimes go with my cousin.
dialogue.zh: 也不总是。我有时和表亲一起去。

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: That sounds fun. I draw in my free time.
dialogue.zh: 听着挺好玩。我有空时画画。

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.en: What do you like to draw?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢画什么？

questions.explanation: Jun 用 Old buildings 回答拍摄对象。
with my cousin 指和表亲一起。
Ada 说 I draw in my free time。

phrases.example: Do you read in your free time?
I take photos of trains.
I sometimes draw with a friend.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 说你有空时做陶艺。
rounds.hint: I make … in my free time.
rounds.sample: I make cups in my free time.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 对方喜欢拍照，问他拍什么。
rounds.sample: What do you take photos of?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方问你总是一个人徒步吗。告诉他有时和妹妹一起。
rounds.sample: Not always. I sometimes go with my sister.

pronunciation.tip: 第一个音节读得更长，第二个音节收在 /z/。放进 take photos 再录一次。

correction.reason: 泛指平时拍照片时，photo 通常用复数 photos。

review.prompt: 不看文本讲自己的一个兴趣，补充一个时间或伙伴。
review.transfer: 听别人说一项兴趣，用一个问题问出细节。

lessons.title: 表达喜欢和不喜欢
lessons.goal: 礼貌表达喜好并找到双方都感兴趣的活动
goals: 用 like 说一项偏好
用 don't really like 表达一项不太喜欢的活动
确认一项共同喜好

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Do you like indoor sports?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢室内运动吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: Yes, I like swimming.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢，我喜欢游泳。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: How about table tennis?
dialogue.zh: 乒乓球呢？

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: I don't really like it. Do you like it?
dialogue.zh: 我不太喜欢。你喜欢吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes, but I like swimming too.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢，不过我也喜欢游泳。

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: Do you like the pool near work?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢单位附近的游泳池吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Yes. I go there on Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢。我周五去那里。

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: Great. Let's go after work this Friday.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我们这周五下班后去吧。

questions.explanation: Lan 喜欢游泳，Ben 也明确说 like swimming too。
Lan 说 I don't really like it，it 指乒乓球。

questions.prompt: 他们准备什么时候去游泳？
questions.explanation: this Friday 和 after work 共同确定时间。

phrases.example: I like reading on the train.

phrases.zh: 语气较缓和地说不太喜欢
phrases.example: I don't really like running.
I like painting too.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 说你喜欢跳舞。
rounds.sample: I like dancing.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 同伴邀你打网球，你不太喜欢。说出你喜欢的另一项运动。
rounds.sample: I don't really like tennis, but I like swimming.

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 听到搭档说喜欢骑车，你也喜欢。说出你们可以去的地方。
rounds.sample: I like cycling too. Let's ride in the park.

pronunciation.tip: 同一语速交替说 I like it 和 I don't really like it。伙伴只凭声音判断赞成哪一项，再核对。

correction.reason: 这里的主语是 I，否定用 don't like。

review.prompt: 对三个不同的活动各说一句真实喜好。
review.transfer: 谈午休活动时找到一项双方都喜欢的事。

rubric: 用 like 说一项偏好
用 don't really like 表达一项不太喜欢的活动
确认一项共同喜好

partnerTask.roleA: 午休室有跳舞、跑步和乒乓球三项活动，你喜欢乒乓球，不太喜欢跑步。
partnerTask.roleB: 你喜欢跳舞和乒乓球，不太喜欢跑步。A 没问到的活动先别直接说。
partnerTask.success: 找出至少一项双方都喜欢的活动，并口头确认。

lessons.title: 给出简单理由
lessons.goal: 用 because 给出具体理由，并回应对方的选择
goals: 用 why 问到原因
用 because 说明一个具体原因
能说出自己更偏好的选择

dialogue.speaker: Fay
dialogue.en: Do you take the bus to work?
dialogue.zh: 你坐公交上班吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Usually, yes. But I walk on Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 通常是。不过我周五走路上班。

dialogue.speaker: Fay
dialogue.en: Why do you walk on Fridays?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么周五走路上班？

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Because I have more time on Fridays.
dialogue.zh: 因为我周五时间更多。

dialogue.speaker: Fay
dialogue.en: Which route do you take?
dialogue.zh: 你走哪条路？

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: I walk through the park because it's quiet.
dialogue.zh: 我穿过公园，因为那里很安静。

dialogue.speaker: Fay
dialogue.en: I prefer the main road. There's a bakery I like.
dialogue.zh: 我更喜欢走大路。那里有一家我喜欢的面包店。

dialogue.speaker: Ren
dialogue.en: Oh, I know that bakery. The bread is good.
dialogue.zh: 哦，我知道那家店。面包不错。

questions.explanation: have more time 是 Ren 给出的理由。
because it's quiet 说明原因。

questions.prompt: Fay 喜欢走大路的原因是什么？
questions.explanation: 她紧接着说 There's a bakery I like。

phrases.zh: 询问对方做某件事的原因
phrases.example: Why do you take the train?

phrases.zh: 说明某样东西有什么特点
phrases.example: I like this room because it's bright.

phrases.zh: 有比较时表达更喜欢哪个
phrases.example: I prefer the bus.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 你喜欢公园，因为那里安静。
rounds.sample: I like the park because it's quiet.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 对方每次都坐地铁，问问原因。
rounds.sample: Why do you take the subway?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方喜欢去热闹的咖啡店，你更爱在家看书，因为比较安静。
rounds.sample: I prefer reading at home because it's quieter.

pronunciation.tip: 说 I walk through the park because it's quiet，把 park 和 quiet 说清楚，because 连过去。再换一个地点和理由试读。

correction.reason: because 后接完整的小句，这里用 it's quiet。

review.prompt: 从喜欢的地点和活动里各选一个，加一句理由。
review.transfer: 解释自己为什么选择某一种通勤方式。

rubric: 用 why 问到原因
用 because 说明一个具体原因
能说出自己更偏好的选择

partnerTask.roleA: 你喜欢在主路附近散步。问搭档偏好哪条路线和原因。
partnerTask.roleB: 你喜欢沿运河走，因为路上几乎没有汽车。你周三和周日才有空。

lessons.title: 为访客选一段午休活动
lessons.englishTitle: A Lunch Break for a Visitor
lessons.goal: 用作息、兴趣、喜好和理由决定一项活动
goals: 说出自己的一个时间限制
按访客喜好提议活动
说明提议为什么合适

dialogue.speaker: Mina
dialogue.en: Our visitor has an hour free at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 我们的访客午餐时间有一小时空闲。

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Do you finish your morning work at twelve?
dialogue.zh: 你上午的工作十二点结束吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mina
dialogue.en: Usually, yes. What does she like to do?
dialogue.zh: 通常是。她喜欢做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: She likes gardens, but she doesn't like long walks.
dialogue.zh: 她喜欢花园，但不喜欢走太久。

dialogue.speaker: Mina
dialogue.en: How about the garden behind our office?
dialogue.zh: 咱们办公室后面的花园怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Good idea. We can go there because it's close.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。那里很近，我们可以去。

dialogue.speaker: Mina
dialogue.en: I usually eat at twelve. Can we go at twelve thirty?
dialogue.zh: 我通常十二点吃饭。我们能十二点半去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Sure. We can call her now.
dialogue.zh: 行。我们现在可以给她打电话。

questions.explanation: doesn't like long walks 给出了要避开的活动。

questions.prompt: 为什么提议去办公楼后面？
questions.explanation: Oli 用 because it's close 解释为什么可行。
Mina 提议 twelve thirty，Oli 表示同意。

phrases.en: She likes…, but she doesn't like…
phrases.zh: 并列说出别人的两种喜好
phrases.example: She likes tea, but she doesn't like coffee.
How about the small museum?
I usually eat at one.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 告诉同伴你通常十二点半吃午饭，之后有半小时。
rounds.sample: I usually eat at twelve thirty. I'm free for half an hour after that.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 访客喜欢看画，不喜欢很吵的地方。提议去附近的小画廊。
rounds.sample: How about the small gallery near here?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 画廊今天关闭，换成安静的书店并说原因。
rounds.sample: Let's go to the bookshop because it's quiet.

pronunciation.tip: 伙伴依次随机读两个时间，写下 12:00 或 12:30。自己复述时，thirty 的 th 轻触舌尖再送气。

correction.reason: 主语为 she 时，用 doesn't 加动词原形 like。

review.prompt: 不看台词，给出活动建议和一句理由。
review.transfer: 同伴午休只有二十分钟，调整活动并说出理由。

rubric: 说出自己的一个时间限制
按访客喜好提议活动
说明提议为什么合适

partnerTask.roleA: 你十二点半才空，想带访客去近一点的地方。问清访客的兴趣和时间。
partnerTask.roleB: 访客喜欢看旧照片，不喜欢户外活动，一点要回去开会。办公室旁有小展厅，照片可以免费看。

lessons.title: 帮新室友选周末活动
lessons.goal: 独立询问日常安排和兴趣，并给出适合两人的方案
goals: 主动问出对方的时间或兴趣
说出一项明确的喜好或限制
确定双方可行的活动和时间，并说明理由

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: What do you usually do on Saturday mornings?
dialogue.zh: 你周六早上通常做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: I shop for food, but I'm free after eleven.
dialogue.zh: 我去买菜，不过十一点后有空。

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: Do you want to go to the market together?
dialogue.zh: 你想一起去集市吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: I don't really like busy places.
dialogue.zh: 我不太喜欢人多的地方。

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: What do you like to do outdoors?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢在户外做什么？

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: I like riding my bike. Do you ride?
dialogue.zh: 我喜欢骑自行车。你骑吗？

dialogue.speaker: Kai
dialogue.en: Yes. We could ride along the canal because it's quiet.
dialogue.zh: 骑。我们可以沿运河骑车，因为那里安静。

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's go at eleven thirty.
dialogue.zh: 好。咱们十一点半出发。

questions.prompt: Sol 周六早上通常做什么？
questions.explanation: shop for food 是采购食物。

questions.prompt: Kai 为什么提议沿运河骑车？
questions.explanation: because it's quiet 解释了路线选择。
Sol 用 Let's go at eleven thirty 确定出发时间。

phrases.zh: 说明什么时候之后有空
phrases.example: I'm free after ten.

phrases.zh: 礼貌说出不太喜欢的特点
phrases.example: I don't really like loud places.
We could walk to the lake because it's close.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 室友只问了周日上午的安排。说你十点后空，并讲一项习惯。
rounds.sample: I call my parents in the morning. I'm free after ten.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 室友不喜欢跑步，你想找替代活动。先问出他的户外偏好。
rounds.sample: What do you like to do outdoors?

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 对方喜欢看花但不能久站，建议坐在植物园里，并解释。
rounds.sample: We could sit in the garden because there are benches there.

pronunciation.tip: 把 busy places 分别放入 I like 和 I don't really like 后面读，听者既要听出地点特点，也要判断喜好。

correction.reason: like 后可接 riding my bike 来说明喜欢的活动。

review.prompt: 从你的回答中回听一条时间和一条理由，检查能否独立听懂。
review.transfer: 换成同事午休安排，重新协商活动和时间。

rubric: 主动问出对方的时间或兴趣
说出一项明确的喜好或限制

partnerTask.roleA: 你周日十点后有空，喜欢安静的地方。和搭档谈妥一种周日活动。
partnerTask.roleB: 你周日十一点半才有空，喜欢拍花，不喜欢拥挤。小公园有花，午后人少。

lessons.title: 点一杯饮料
lessons.goal: 说清饮料、大小和堂食或外带
goals: 点出一种饮料
说清杯型和冷热
回答堂食或外带

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Hi! What can I get for you?
dialogue.zh: 你好！要喝点什么？

dialogue.speaker: Dee
dialogue.en: I'd like a hot tea, please.
dialogue.zh: 我想要一杯热茶。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Small or large?
dialogue.zh: 小杯还是大杯？

dialogue.speaker: Dee
dialogue.en: Small, please. Do you have green tea?
dialogue.zh: 小杯，谢谢。有绿茶吗？

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: Yes, we do. Is that for here or to go?
dialogue.zh: 有。您在这儿喝还是带走？

dialogue.speaker: Dee
dialogue.en: To go, please. No milk.
dialogue.zh: 带走，谢谢。不加奶。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.en: One small hot green tea to go, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就是一小杯热绿茶，带走。

dialogue.speaker: Dee
dialogue.en: That's right. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 没错，谢谢。

questions.explanation: 客人先说 hot tea，再确认选 green tea。
Small, please 回答杯型。

questions.prompt: 客人选了哪种取餐方式？
questions.explanation: To go 是外带。

phrases.example: I'd like an iced coffee, please.
Is that for here or to go?
A small coffee to go, please.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 点一小杯热咖啡。
rounds.sample: I'd like a small hot coffee, please.

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 店员问你堂食还是外带，选择堂食。
rounds.sample: For here, please.

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 店员误以为你点的是热茶，改成大杯冰茶并选外带。
rounds.sample: A large iced tea to go, please.

pronunciation.tip: 请同伴随机说 hot tea 或 iced tea。听完指向热饮或冷饮，然后复述整组词。

correction.reason: 点一杯时可用 a small coffee。

review.prompt: 先点一次热饮，再换一种冷饮，轮流回答杯型和是否外带。

rubric: 点出一种饮料
说清杯型和冷热

partnerTask.roleA: 你想要小杯冰茶外带。仅知道店里有茶，向店员确认品种。
partnerTask.roleB: 绿茶只有热的，冰茶只有红茶。小杯有货。

lessons.title: 说清点餐数量
lessons.goal: 下单时正确说明份数，并核对总数
goals: 前两项食物的数量说对
说明哪一项是大家分着吃
听出并更正店员回读的数量

dialogue.speaker: Nell
dialogue.en: Are you ready to order?
dialogue.zh: 您准备好点餐了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.en: Yes. Can we have two bowls of soup, please?
dialogue.zh: 准备好了。请给我们两碗汤。

dialogue.speaker: Nell
dialogue.en: Sure. Would you like any bread?
dialogue.zh: 好的。还要面包吗？

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.en: Yes, one bread roll to share.
dialogue.zh: 要，一个小面包，两个人分着吃。

dialogue.speaker: Nell
dialogue.en: Anything else?
dialogue.zh: 还需要别的吗？

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.en: One salad, please. That's all.
dialogue.zh: 再来一份沙拉。就这些。

dialogue.speaker: Nell
dialogue.en: So, two soups, one roll, and one salad?
dialogue.zh: 两份汤、一个小面包和一份沙拉，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: Hao
dialogue.en: Yes. Thanks for checking.
dialogue.zh: 对。谢谢您核对。

questions.explanation: two bowls of soup 意思是两碗汤。
to share 紧跟在 one bread roll 后面。
客人最后说 One salad, please。

phrases.example: Can we have two sandwiches?
One plate of chips to share, please.
Two rolls, please. That's all.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 为两个人点两碗汤。
rounds.sample: Can we have two bowls of soup?

rounds.title: 半开放
rounds.prompt: 再加一份两个人分的薯条。
rounds.sample: One plate of chips to share, please.

rounds.title: 换情境
rounds.prompt: 店员回读成三份汤，纠正为一份汤，再确认沙拉是两份。
rounds.sample: One soup, please, and two salads.

pronunciation.tip: 对比 one bowl 和 two bowls。读后让对方写下数量，留意数字与 bowls 的收尾都能帮助判断。

correction.reason: two 后面的可数名词 bowl 用复数 bowls。

review.prompt: 给自己写一张有三种食物的便签，反过来只看食物和数字练点单。

dialogue.speaker: Ash
dialogue.en: Could we get three pizzas for here?
dialogue.zh: 我们能点三份披萨在这里吃吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Sure. Which ones would you like?
dialogue.zh: 好的，你们想要哪几种？

dialogue.speaker: Ash
dialogue.en: Two mushroom pizzas and one cheese pizza, please.
dialogue.zh: 两份蘑菇披萨，一份奶酪披萨。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: We only have one mushroom pizza left.
dialogue.zh: 我们只剩一份蘑菇披萨了。

dialogue.speaker: Ash
dialogue.en: Then one mushroom and two cheese, please.
dialogue.zh: 那就一份蘑菇，两份奶酪吧。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Would you like chili oil with those?
dialogue.zh: 需要配辣椒油吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ash
dialogue.en: Yes, on the side, please. And two glasses of water.
dialogue.zh: 要，请另放。再来两杯水。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Three pizzas and three waters?
dialogue.zh: 三份披萨和三杯水，对吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ash
dialogue.en: Two waters, please. Three pizzas is right.
dialogue.zh: 请给两杯水。披萨是三份，没错。

dialogue.speaker: Nel
dialogue.en: Are you free sometime this week?
dialogue.zh: 你这周什么时候有空吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ian
dialogue.en: I'm free on Thursday after work.
dialogue.zh: 我周四下班后有空。

dialogue.speaker: Nel
dialogue.en: How about Friday? I work late on Thursday.
dialogue.zh: 周五呢？我周四得工作到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: Ian
dialogue.en: I can't do Friday. I have a class.
dialogue.zh: 周五我不行。我有课。

dialogue.speaker: Nel
dialogue.en: Are you free on Saturday morning?
dialogue.zh: 你周六早上有空吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ian
dialogue.en: Yes, after ten. Are you free then?
dialogue.zh: 有，十点之后。你那时有空吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nel
dialogue.en: Yes. Let's meet at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 有。我们十一点见吧。

dialogue.speaker: Ian
dialogue.en: Eleven works for me.
dialogue.zh: 十一点我可以。

Ian 说 I have a class。

dialogue.speaker: Moe
dialogue.en: Can we meet on the fifteenth?
dialogue.zh: 我们可以十五号见面吗？

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.en: Did you say the fifth or the fifteenth?
dialogue.zh: 你说的是五号还是十五号？

dialogue.speaker: Moe
dialogue.en: The fifteenth. That's a Friday.
dialogue.zh: 十五号，那天是周五。

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.en: What time should we meet?
dialogue.zh: 我们几点见？

dialogue.speaker: Moe
dialogue.en: How about half past two in the afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 下午两点半怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.en: That works. Where should we meet?
dialogue.zh: 可以。我们在哪儿见？

dialogue.speaker: Moe
dialogue.en: Outside the library, by the main door.
dialogue.zh: 在图书馆外面，正门旁。

dialogue.speaker: Kim
dialogue.en: Okay. Friday the fifteenth, two thirty, at the library.
dialogue.zh: 好，周五十五号，两点半，图书馆见。

questions.explanation: Moe 明确重复 the fifteenth，并补充周五。

lessons.title: 昨天做了什么

dialogue.speaker: Ping
dialogue.en: What did you do after work yesterday?
dialogue.zh: 你昨天下班后做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: I went to the market and bought some fruit.
dialogue.zh: 我去了市场，买了点水果。

dialogue.speaker: Ping
dialogue.en: What time did you get to the market?
dialogue.zh: 你几点到市场的？

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: Around seven. It was still open when I got there.
dialogue.zh: 七点左右，我到的时候还开着。

dialogue.speaker: Ping
dialogue.en: Did you go straight home after that?
dialogue.zh: 之后你直接回家了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: No, I met my sister for dinner near the market.
dialogue.zh: 没有，我在市场附近跟我妹妹吃了晚饭。

dialogue.speaker: Ping
dialogue.en: Where did you eat? I'm looking for a place nearby.
dialogue.zh: 你们在哪儿吃的？我在找附近的餐馆。

dialogue.speaker: Uma
dialogue.en: We ate at a little café on Plum Street.
dialogue.zh: 我们在梅树街一家小咖啡馆吃的。

questions.explanation: bought some fruit 表示买了水果。
Around seven 大约七点。

questions.explanation: 她说 met my sister for dinner。

I went to the bakery and bought some bread.
Did you call him after that?

lessons.title: 聊聊周末
lessons.goal: 说清周末活动并追问细节

dialogue.speaker: Fang
dialogue.en: How was your weekend? Did you get outside at all?
dialogue.zh: 周末过得怎么样？出去走走了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Zed
dialogue.en: Yes, I went to Reed Lake on Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 出去了，我周日去了芦苇湖。

dialogue.speaker: Fang
dialogue.en: Did you go there alone or with friends?
dialogue.zh: 你是一个人去的，还是跟朋友一起？

dialogue.speaker: Zed
dialogue.en: I went with my cousin. We took a picnic lunch.
dialogue.zh: 跟表亲一起去的。我们带了野餐午饭。

dialogue.speaker: Fang
dialogue.en: What did you do after you ate?
dialogue.zh: 吃完之后你做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Zed
dialogue.en: We walked around the lake for an hour.
dialogue.zh: 我们绕湖走了一个小时。

dialogue.speaker: Fang
dialogue.en: Was the path busy in the afternoon?
dialogue.zh: 下午那条步道上人多吗？

dialogue.speaker: Zed
dialogue.en: No, it was quiet. Most people left after lunch.
dialogue.zh: 不多，很安静。大多数人午饭后就走了。

questions.explanation: on Sunday 指周日。
I went with my cousin 说明同行人。
it was quiet 表示人少安静。

phrases.example: Hi, how was your weekend?
Did you go there alone or with your family?
We talked for an hour.

correction.after: We were at the lake on Sunday.

lessons.title: 按顺序讲一件事
lessons.goal: 按时间顺序讲述三步经历

dialogue.speaker: Xiu
dialogue.en: What did you do when you got to the garden sale?
dialogue.zh: 你到园艺义卖会之后做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.en: First, I looked at the plants by the gate.
dialogue.zh: 我先看了门边的植物。

dialogue.speaker: Xiu
dialogue.en: Did you buy any plants there?
dialogue.zh: 你在那里买植物了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.en: Yes. Then I bought two small plants for my desk.
dialogue.zh: 买了。接着我买了两盆小植物放桌上。

dialogue.speaker: Xiu
dialogue.en: Where did you go after that?
dialogue.zh: 那之后你去了哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.en: After that, I helped my friend at her table.
dialogue.zh: 之后我去我朋友的摊位帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Xiu
dialogue.en: Did you stay until the end of the sale?
dialogue.zh: 你一直待到义卖结束吗？

dialogue.speaker: Raj
dialogue.en: Yes. Finally, we packed the boxes and went home.
dialogue.zh: 对。最后我们收拾好箱子就回家了。

questions.explanation: First 指向门边看植物。
After that 后说帮朋友。
Finally 后说明收箱回家。

phrases.example: First, I called my friend.
Then I walked to the shop.
Finally, we took a bus home.

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: How did your first cooking class go yesterday?
dialogue.zh: 你昨天第一堂烹饪课上得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: I was nervous at first. I didn't know anyone.
dialogue.zh: 一开始我有点紧张，一个人都不认识。

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: Did you cook by yourself in the class?
dialogue.zh: 在课上你自己做菜了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: No, I worked with a woman at my table.
dialogue.zh: 没有，我和同桌的一位女士一起做的。

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: What did the two of you make?
dialogue.zh: 你们俩做了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: We made soup, and it tasted good in the end.
dialogue.zh: 我们做了汤，最后味道挺好。

dialogue.speaker: Chen
dialogue.en: So how did you feel after the class?
dialogue.zh: 那下课后你觉得怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: I was glad because I learned something new.
dialogue.zh: 我很高兴，因为学到了新东西。

because I learned something new 给出原因。

We found the shop in the end.
I was glad because my team finished on time.

dialogue.zh: 老师因为下雨取消课程了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: No. First, she checked a room at Maple Hall.
dialogue.zh: 没有。她先去看了枫树会堂的一个房间。

dialogue.speaker: Yan
dialogue.en: What happened after she checked the room?
dialogue.zh: 她看完房间后发生了什么？

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: Then we carried the speakers inside and started dancing.
dialogue.zh: 接着我们把音箱搬进去，开始跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: Yan
dialogue.en: Were you happy with the new place?
dialogue.zh: 你喜欢新的上课地点吗？

dialogue.speaker: Ada
dialogue.en: Yes, I was surprised. We had more space inside.
dialogue.zh: 喜欢，我很惊喜。里面的空间更大。

questions.explanation: right before the class 指快要上课时。
First, she checked a room 说明先看房间。
We had more space inside 解释惊喜。

phrases.example: Did they cancel the meeting?
What happened after you got there?
I was surprised because the room was big.

lessons.title: 说说今晚的计划
lessons.goal: 询问近期安排并说明空闲时间

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: What are you doing after work tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你今晚下班后有什么安排？

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.en: I'm going to pick up a package at six.
dialogue.zh: 我打算六点去取包裹。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Are you busy for the rest of the evening?
dialogue.zh: 你今晚剩下的时间有事吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.en: I need to cook dinner, but I'm free after eight.
dialogue.zh: 我得做晚饭，不过八点以后有空。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Are you going to call Mei tonight?
dialogue.zh: 你今晚打算给 Mei 打电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.en: No, I'm going to call her tomorrow at lunch.
dialogue.zh: 不，我打算明天午饭时给她打电话。

dialogue.speaker: Lin
dialogue.en: Okay. Can I call you after eight tonight?
dialogue.zh: 好，那我今晚八点以后可以给你打电话吗？

dialogue.speaker: Dev
dialogue.en: Sure. I'll be at home then.
dialogue.zh: 可以，那时我在家。

questions.explanation: pick up a package 表示取包裹。

questions.prompt: Dev 今晚几点以后有空？
questions.explanation: I'm free after eight 给出可用时段。
tomorrow at lunch 说明时间。

phrases.example: What are you doing tomorrow afternoon?
I'm going to buy some groceries.
I'm free after seven.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 问同事明天下班后有什么安排。
rounds.sample: What are you doing after work tomorrow?

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 明天晚上六点要买菜，七点以后有空。

rounds.title: 换条件

rounds.hint: on my way home; at eight
rounds.sample: I'll be on my way home then. Can we talk at eight?

correction.before: I going to pick up a package.
correction.after: I'm going to pick up a package.
correction.reason: be going to 的主语为 I 时用 am。

lessons.title: 提出一个做法
lessons.goal: 在共同目标下提出活动和时间

dialogue.speaker: Mao
dialogue.en: We have some time before dinner. What can we do?
dialogue.zh: 晚饭前还有些时间。我们做点什么？

dialogue.speaker: June
dialogue.en: How about a short walk by the river?
dialogue.zh: 去河边散一小会儿步怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Mao
dialogue.en: That sounds nice. Which path should we take?
dialogue.zh: 听起来不错。我们走哪条路？

dialogue.speaker: June
dialogue.en: Let's take the path behind the coffee shop.
dialogue.zh: 走咖啡店后面的小路吧。

dialogue.speaker: Mao
dialogue.en: Do we have time to walk all the way to the bridge?
dialogue.zh: 我们来得及一直走到桥那里吗？

dialogue.speaker: June
dialogue.en: Yes, but let's leave at six so we have enough time.
dialogue.zh: 来得及，不过我们六点出发，这样时间就够了。

dialogue.speaker: Mao
dialogue.en: Okay. Shall we meet outside the coffee shop first?
dialogue.zh: 好。我们先在咖啡店外见面怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: June
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll see you there at six.
dialogue.zh: 好，六点在那儿见。

questions.prompt: 为什么想安排一个短活动？
questions.explanation: before dinner 表示活动在晚饭前。
path behind the coffee shop 指定路线。
outside the coffee shop 是见面点。

phrases.example: How about a quick coffee?
Let's take the bus to the park.
Shall we meet outside the library?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 给下班后有二十分钟空闲的同事提议喝咖啡。
rounds.sample: How about a quick coffee after work?

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 同事接受。提议去车站附近的咖啡店。
rounds.sample: Let's go to the café near the station.

rounds.title: 换条件
rounds.prompt: 车站门口正在施工，改约在书店门口见。
rounds.sample: Shall we meet outside the bookshop at five?

pronunciation.tip: 先读 How aBOUT，再加 a short WALK；让 WALK 清晰突出，功能词读轻。

correction.reason: Let's 后面直接接动词原形。

review.prompt: 用 How about 和 Let's 各说一个建议。

lessons.title: 接受或婉拒
lessons.goal: 清楚答应或简短说明不能参加

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: Would you like to see a movie with me on Friday?
dialogue.zh: 你周五愿意和我一起看电影吗？

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: I'd love to, but I'm working late on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我很想去，不过周五要加班到很晚。

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: I see. The movie is on Saturday too.
dialogue.zh: 这样啊。周六也放这部电影。

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Saturday works for me. What time is the movie?
dialogue.zh: 周六我可以。电影几点？

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: There's a show at two and another one at five.
dialogue.zh: 两点有一场，五点还有一场。

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Two is a little early for me. Is five okay?
dialogue.zh: 两点对我有点早。五点可以吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lan
dialogue.en: Yes, five is fine. Let's meet at the cinema at four thirty.
dialogue.zh: 五点可以。我们四点半在电影院见吧。

dialogue.speaker: Oli
dialogue.en: Great. See you there on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，周六在那里见。

questions.explanation: I'm working late on Friday 交代原因。
Yes, five is fine 确认五点场。
meet at the cinema at four thirty 约的是碰面。

phrases.example: Would you like to have lunch with me?
I'd love to, but I have a class tonight.
Sunday works for me.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 邀请同事周四晚上一起吃面。
rounds.sample: Would you like to get noodles with me on Thursday evening?

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 朋友邀请你星期四吃饭，你要上课。礼貌婉拒。
rounds.sample: I'd love to, but I have a class on Thursday.

rounds.title: 换条件
rounds.prompt: 朋友改提周日十二点。你能接受，并确认在餐厅见。
rounds.sample: Sunday at twelve works for me. See you at the restaurant.

pronunciation.tip: 先读 I would love to，再读 I'd love to。保留 I'd 结尾的短促 /d/，把 love 读重。

correction.reason: 主语 Saturday 是单数，work 在这里用 works。

review.prompt: 对一条邀请分别练接受和婉拒。
review.transfer: 用两种方式回应一次午休运动邀请。

rubric: 礼貌发出带时间的邀请
婉拒并简短交代原因

partnerTask.roleA: 你想约同伴听现场音乐，周四八点和周六四点有场，自己两场都可以。

婉拒并简短交代原因

lessons.title: 原计划不行怎么办
lessons.goal: 指出限制并提议替代地点

dialogue.speaker: Qi
dialogue.en: Are we still meeting at the park at eleven tomorrow?
dialogue.zh: 我们明天还是十一点在公园见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pat
dialogue.en: I'd like to, but it's going to rain tomorrow morning.
dialogue.zh: 我想去，不过明早要下雨。

dialogue.speaker: Qi
dialogue.en: Could we meet somewhere indoors instead?
dialogue.zh: 那我们能改在室内见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pat
dialogue.en: Sure. How about the café by Oak Station?
dialogue.zh: 可以。橡树站旁的咖啡店怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Qi
dialogue.en: That café is closed on Mondays. Is the bakery open?
dialogue.zh: 那家咖啡店周一关门。面包店开门吗？

dialogue.speaker: Pat
dialogue.en: Yes, and there are tables inside. Eleven still works for me.
dialogue.zh: 开，里面有桌子。十一点我还是有空。

dialogue.speaker: Qi
dialogue.en: Great, let's meet inside the bakery at eleven.
dialogue.zh: 好，我们十一点在面包店里面见。

dialogue.speaker: Pat
dialogue.en: Okay, see you tomorrow at the bakery.
dialogue.zh: 好，明天面包店见。

questions.explanation: it's going to rain tomorrow morning 给出原因。
closed on Mondays 意为周一歇业。
inside the bakery at eleven 是确认过的安排。

phrases.example: Are we still meeting at the library?

phrases.en: Could we meet somewhere indoors instead?
phrases.example: Could we meet at the mall instead?
Friday still works for me.

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 确认明天下午两点是否还在图书馆见。
rounds.sample: Are we still meeting at the library at two tomorrow?

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 图书馆装修。提议改在有座位的茶馆见。
rounds.sample: The library is closed. Could we meet at the tea shop instead?

rounds.title: 换条件
rounds.prompt: 茶馆三点才开，小餐馆两点可用。保留原时间并确认新地点。
rounds.sample: Two still works for me. Let's meet at the little restaurant at two.

pronunciation.tip: 先读最后一个音节 stead，再轻接 in，说完整个替代提议。

correction.before: Could we to meet indoors instead?
correction.reason: could 后面接动词原形 meet。

review.prompt: 保留原时间，口头换掉地点；再交换条件。
review.transfer: 为突然维修的服务点重约地点。

rubric: 指出原计划遇到的限制
提出另一地点并检查可用性
复述最后达成的时间和地点

goals: 指出原计划遇到的限制
提出另一地点并检查可用性

lessons.title: 重新约一次午餐
lessons.goal: 整合计划、建议、婉拒和替代安排

dialogue.speaker: Hui
dialogue.en: Are we still having lunch together on Wednesday?
dialogue.zh: 我们周三还是一起吃午饭吗？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I'm going to meet a new client at noon.
dialogue.zh: 我中午要见一位新客户。

dialogue.speaker: Hui
dialogue.en: Could we have lunch a little later, around one?
dialogue.zh: 能不能稍晚一点，大约一点吃？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: I'd love to, but I have a call at one.
dialogue.zh: 我很想去，不过我一点要开个电话会。

dialogue.speaker: Hui
dialogue.en: How about Thursday at twelve thirty, then?
dialogue.zh: 那周四十二点半怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Thursday works for me. Can we eat near the office?
dialogue.zh: 周四可以。我们能在办公室附近吃吗？

dialogue.speaker: Hui
dialogue.en: Sure. Let's meet at the noodle shop across the street.
dialogue.zh: 可以。我们在马路对面的面馆见吧。

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.en: Great. Thursday at twelve thirty at the noodle shop.
dialogue.zh: 好，周四十二点半面馆见。

questions.prompt: 周三中午对方要做什么？
questions.explanation: meet a new client 指见一位新客户。
I have a call at one 是理由。

questions.prompt: 什么时候最后确定吃午饭？
questions.explanation: 最后一句重复了 Thursday at twelve thirty。

phrases.example: Are we still having dinner on Friday?
Could we start a little later?
How about Thursday at six, then?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 确认周二仍然一起喝早茶，并问对方几点有空。
rounds.sample: Are we still having tea on Tuesday? What time are you free?

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 对方提议九点，但你九点有会，礼貌婉拒并提议十点。
rounds.hint: I'd love to, but; how about
rounds.sample: I'd love to, but I have a meeting at nine. How about ten?

rounds.title: 换条件
rounds.prompt: 周二全天不行，改到周五八点半，并确认就在办公室楼下。
rounds.sample: Friday at eight thirty works for me. Let's meet downstairs at the office.

pronunciation.tip: 舌尖轻伸在上下齿之间送气发 /θ/，再接后面的音，按自己的速度读日期。

correction.before: How about we meeting on Thursday?
correction.reason: How about 直接接动词时用 -ing 形式。

review.prompt: 轮流更换冲突原因和替代日期。
review.transfer: 和同伴为一段课后练习另约时间地点。

lessons.title: 改约取展板
lessons.goal: 根据约束协商全新的共同计划

dialogue.speaker: Nan
dialogue.en: When are you going to pick up the boards for the fair?
dialogue.zh: 你打算什么时候去取市集要用的展板？

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: I planned to go at five on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 我原计划周六五点去。

dialogue.speaker: Nan
dialogue.en: The shop closes at four that day. Could we go earlier?
dialogue.zh: 那家店当天四点关门。我们可以早点去吗？

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: I can't get there before four. I'm helping my neighbor move.
dialogue.zh: 我四点前到不了。我得帮邻居搬家。

dialogue.speaker: Nan
dialogue.en: How about Sunday morning instead? The shop opens at nine.
dialogue.zh: 那改周日早上呢？那家店九点开。

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: That works. Can we meet by the shop door at nine fifteen?
dialogue.zh: 可以。九点一刻在店门口见行吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nan
dialogue.en: Yes, I'll bring my cart to carry the boards.
dialogue.zh: 行，我会带小推车运展板。

dialogue.speaker: Sol
dialogue.en: Perfect. See you by the door on Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 好极了。周日在门口见。

questions.prompt: 周六原计划几点取展板？
questions.explanation: I planned to go at five on Saturday 说的是原计划。

questions.prompt: 周六提早去为何行不通？
questions.explanation: I'm helping my neighbor move 指帮助邻居搬家。
双方接受 at nine fifteen。

phrases.example: When are you going to pick up the keys?
Could we start earlier?
How about Monday evening instead?

rounds.title: 有提示
rounds.prompt: 两人原约周二五点取钥匙。询问对方那天什么时候去。

rounds.title: 独立开口
rounds.prompt: 你四点前在上课，而领钥匙的办公室四点关门。告知你不能早到。
rounds.sample: I can't get there before four. I have a class.

rounds.title: 换条件
rounds.prompt: 办公室周三早上八点开门，双方九点上班。提议八点一刻在前台见，并确认。
rounds.sample: How about Wednesday at eight fifteen? Let's meet at the front desk.

pronunciation.tip: 读 nine fifteen，把 -teen 读重并保留末尾 /n/，对照 nine fifty。

correction.reason: 情态动词 could 后用动词原形 go。

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.en: Yes, it can. Take the paper from this box because that printer is empty.
dialogue.zh: 可以。从这个盒子拿纸，那台机器没纸了。

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.zh: 太好了，我带点纸过去。谢谢你帮忙。

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Sure. Where should we meet? I have never been to that cinema.
dialogue.zh: 好。我们在哪儿见？我没去过那家影院。

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.zh: 好啊。如果我先到，就先找张桌子。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: How should we get to the market tomorrow? We could take the bus or walk.
dialogue.zh: 我们明天怎么去市场？可以坐公交，也可以步行。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: I prefer to walk because the streets are quiet in the morning.
dialogue.zh: 我更想走路，因为早上的街道很安静。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: I like walking, too. But I need to carry a big bag home from the market.
dialogue.zh: 我也喜欢走路。不过我得从市场提个大包回家。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Good point. How about walking there and taking the bus home?
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我们走过去，回家时坐公交怎么样？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: That sounds good. The bus stop is right next to the market door.
dialogue.zh: 听起来不错。公交站就在市场门边。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Do you know how often the bus comes on a Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 你知道周六公交多久一班吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Every twenty minutes, I think. We can check the time at the stop.
dialogue.zh: 我想是二十分钟一班。我们可以到站牌那里看时间。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Okay, let's take a walk there and check the bus time before we shop.
dialogue.zh: 好，咱们走过去，在买东西前看看公交时间。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: A cup of tea is included. Coffee costs two dollars more.
dialogue.zh: 包含一杯茶。要咖啡就多加两美元。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: So the lunch with coffee is fourteen dollars in total, right?

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.en: Sorry, I think there is a mix-up. We want to eat here, please.
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，好像弄错了。我们要在这儿吃，谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.zh: 谢谢。还有一件事，我们点的是一份鸡肉三明治和一份芝士三明治。

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Hello, I left something at the station. It is a small case for my glasses.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我有东西忘在车站了。是一个装眼镜的小盒子。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: We found two glasses cases today. What does yours look like?
dialogue.zh: 我们今天捡到了两个眼镜盒。你的是什么样子？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: It is brown, and it has a white star on top. It opens like a little box.
dialogue.zh: 它是棕色的，上面有颗白星星。它像小盒子那样打开。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: I have that case here. You can collect it from the front desk before five fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 那个盒子在我这儿。你可以五点十五前来前台取。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Could you repeat the time more slowly? Did you say five fifty?
dialogue.zh: 时间能慢一点再说吗？你说五点五十吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Five fifteen, a quarter past five. After that, come to the ticket office instead.
dialogue.zh: 五点十五，五点一刻。再晚的话就去售票处。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Thanks. I will be there at five thirty, so I should go to the ticket office.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我五点半到，所以我应该去售票处。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Exactly. Tell them it is the brown case with the white star on top.
dialogue.zh: 没错。告诉他们是带白色星星的棕色盒子。

dialogue.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the music room near West Park?

dialogue.speaker: Eli

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Could you say the stop again? Did you say Lake Road or Lake Street?
dialogue.zh: 能再说一遍站名吗？你说的是湖路还是湖街？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Lake Road. There is a big blue sign at the stop, so it is easy to see.
dialogue.zh: 湖路。车站有块蓝色大牌子，很容易看到。

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.zh: 谢谢。我在湖路下车，教室在面包店旁边，对吧？

dialogue.en: Yes, I am Eli. I moved here last month, and I am still learning where things are.
dialogue.zh: 是的，我叫 Eli。我上个月搬来，还在熟悉附近的地方。

dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. Do you like drawing, or are you here to try something new?
dialogue.zh: 很高兴认识你。你喜欢画画，还是想来试试新东西？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: I like drawing outside. Last weekend I drew the trees in Plum Park.

dialogue.speaker: Nora

dialogue.en: Usually, yes. Today the bus stops on Hill Street because this road is closed.
dialogue.zh: 平时是。今天这条路封了，公交改在山街停靠。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: How do I get to Hill Street from here? I need to catch a train at five.
dialogue.zh: 我从这里怎么到山街？我得赶五点的火车。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Go past the bank and turn left. It is a five-minute walk to the stop.
dialogue.zh: 走过银行后左转。到站台走五分钟。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Is the bus fast? It is already half past four, and I still need to buy a ticket.
dialogue.zh: 这趟车快吗？已经四点半了，我还要买火车票。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: The bus takes twenty minutes. You can walk to the station in fifteen minutes through the park.
dialogue.zh: 公交要二十分钟。从公园穿过去，走到车站只要十五分钟。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: I will walk through the park, then. Is the park gate right after the bank?
dialogue.zh: 那我从公园走过去。公园入口就在银行后面吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Yes, turn right after the bank for the park. Turn left for the bus stop.
dialogue.zh: 对，过银行后右转去公园，左转去公交站。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Can I get two small apple pies to take away, please?
dialogue.zh: 请给我两份小苹果派外带。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: We only have one apple pie left. We also have small lemon cakes for four dollars each.
dialogue.zh: 苹果派只剩一个了。我们也有小柠檬蛋糕，每个四美元。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Is the lemon cake very sweet? One of us likes things that are less sweet.
dialogue.zh: 柠檬蛋糕很甜吗？我们有个人喜欢没那么甜的东西。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: It is less sweet than the apple pie. Would you like one of each?
dialogue.zh: 它没有苹果派甜。你要每种各来一个吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Yes, please. How much is that in total? I have ten dollars in cash.
dialogue.zh: 好，一共多少钱？我有十美元现金。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: The pie is five dollars, so it is nine dollars for both.
dialogue.zh: 苹果派五美元，两样加起来九美元。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Great. Can you put them in separate bags? The lemon cake is for my friend.
dialogue.zh: 好。能分开装袋吗？柠檬蛋糕是给我朋友的。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Hi, I would like to try the short dance class. Do you have a place this Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我想试试舞蹈体验课。本周六有空位吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Saturday is full, but we have a place on Sunday at eleven. Are you free then?
dialogue.zh: 周六满了，不过周日十一点还有空位。你那时有空吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: I am free on Sunday morning. Do I need to bring any special shoes?
dialogue.zh: 我周日上午有空。需要带专门的鞋吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Clean shoes are fine. Please come ten minutes early so we can show you the room.
dialogue.zh: 干净的鞋就行。请提前十分钟到，我们好带你去教室。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: So I should be there at ten fifty. Is the class in the room by the front door?
dialogue.zh: 所以我十点五十该到。是在正门旁的房间上课吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: It is in the back room, but please come to the front desk first.
dialogue.zh: 在后面的房间上课，不过请先到前台。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Got it. I will bring clean shoes and come to the front desk before eleven.
dialogue.zh: 知道了。我会带干净的鞋，十一点前到前台。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Great. I will put your name down for Sunday. See you then.
dialogue.zh: 好。我给你登记周日的名额。到时见。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Hi, I will get to Maple Station at two. Where should we meet?
dialogue.zh: 你好，我两点到枫树站。我们在哪儿见？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Meet me at the east door. The west door is closed, and the east door is by the taxi stop.
dialogue.zh: 在东门见我。西门关了，东门就在出租车停靠点旁。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Got it, the east door. Can we buy a small gift for my host before we go?
dialogue.zh: 知道了，东门。走之前能给我借住的那家人买个小礼物吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Sure. There is a tea shop near the station. How much do you want to spend?
dialogue.zh: 当然。车站附近有家茶叶店。你想花多少钱？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: About twelve dollars. I saw a nice tin of tea on the shop's website yesterday.
dialogue.zh: 大概十二美元。我昨天在店的网站上看到一罐不错的茶。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: The tin costs sixteen dollars, but a small box of tea is ten. The shop closes at three.
dialogue.zh: 那罐要十六美元，不过小盒茶十美元。商店三点关门。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: I will get the small box then. We can walk straight to the shop after we meet.
dialogue.zh: 那我买小盒的。我们见面后直接走去那家店吧。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Good idea. Two at the east door, then we go to the tea shop.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。两点东门见，然后去茶叶店。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Hi, I am Nora from the photo group. Are you the new member coming to the show with me?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是摄影小组的 Nora。你是要和我一起看展的新成员吗？

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Yes, I am Eli. My bus gets to Elm Stop at ten thirty. Is that near the hall?
dialogue.zh: 对，我叫 Eli。我的公交十点半到榆树站。离展馆近吗？

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: Yes, but the hall's main door is closed today. We can meet at the side door by the bookshop.
dialogue.zh: 近，不过展馆正门今天关闭。我们可以在书店旁的侧门见。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Did you say the door by the bus stop? I have not been there before.
dialogue.zh: 你说的是公交站旁的门吗？我没去过那儿。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: The door by the bookshop. From the bus stop, cross the street and turn right.
dialogue.zh: 书店旁的门。从公交站过马路，向右转。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Thanks. Can we get a snack before we go in? I have eight dollars, and I do not eat meat.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢。进去前能买点吃的吗？我有八美元，而且不吃肉。

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.en: The fruit cup is six dollars, but the cheese roll is nine. We can get the fruit cup at the bookshop cafe.
dialogue.zh: 水果杯六美元，芝士卷九美元。我们可以在书店的咖啡区买水果杯。

dialogue.speaker: Eli
dialogue.en: Great. I'll see you at the side door at ten forty, then we can get the fruit.
dialogue.zh: 好。我十点四十在侧门见你，然后我们去买水果杯。
